entities.summary:
Jens Ludwig is the lead guitarist and co-founder
of the German power metal band Edguy. Jens has played nearly all the band's lead parts and guitar solos since their inception and is the only member of the current line-up other than Tobias Sammet to have any songwriting credits. He also contributed lead guitar work for Sammet's Avantasia side project, on both The Metal Opera and The Metal Opera Part II. In 2021, Ludwig and vocalist Nando Fernandes formed a new band, The Grandmaster. He has an endorsement with Gibson guitars, Marshall amplifiers, Ernie Ball - Strings Music Man (company), Vox Amps, Shure mics & wireless equipment, Kemper Profiling Amps and others.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a lead guitarist and co-founder of Edguy, Jens Ludwig has contributed to the band's success with nearly all their lead parts and guitar solos, and has also worked on Tobias Sammet's Avantasia side project. His work in these bands has helped shape the power metal genre.
